head: MacPaw's new Eney assistant asks before it acts on your Mac
dek: MacPaw launched Eney, an AI assistant for Mac that suggests next steps, takes meeting notes without a bot joining the call, and works with Mail, Calendar and Reminders. It asks before it sends a message, changes an event or moves a file.
details: Press Option-W to translate text, convert prices, turn dates into calendar events or pull text from images. It also connects to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Slack and Notion. After a 14-day free trial, plans start at $14.99 a month. It needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later; an iPhone app is on the App Store.
where: Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later) at eney.ai; iPhone app on the App Store
means: An assistant that takes care of small chores on your Mac but waits for your OK before it changes anything.
todo: Download it from eney.ai and use the 14-day trial to see whether it saves you time before paying $14.99 a month.
